target_customer: Employers buying inclusive mental health benefits for employees and families
problem: Employee mental health benefits (EAPs) are poorly used and not culturally responsive; Therify offers culturally responsive in-network therapists.

founders.name: James Murray
founders.background_notes: Led partnerships with digital news organizations at Facebook and Instagram; enterprise sales at InVision (YC page).

founders.name: Warren Sadler
founders.background_notes: Musician and designer early in career (YC page).

technical_complexity.rationale: Marketplace and web platform; the hard part is provider network and insurance operations.

defensibility.rationale: Employer contracts and provider network help; many competitors.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Not researched; names are known incumbents of the category, not dated sources.

market_need_then: No dated evidence of demand was gathered; the YC page frames the need as inclusive, culturally responsive employer mental health care.

brand_strength.rationale: Wordmark only; no external brand evidence. Name is an invented therapy-derived coinage (origin not sourced).

outcome_analysis: Therify, YC S21, appears still operating (site shows 2026 footer and named employer customers such as Indeed and Thumbtack) with a listed team of 3. No funding, exit or failure data was found; claims such as zero client churn are marketing statements.
notes: YC page says team size 3 while site claims employer customers; stale data possible. Site metrics are vendor claims. Research limit: the shared WebSearch budget was exhausted before any outcome, funding, competitor or branding search could run, so only the YC page and company site were read; competition_at_founding is left empty (no dated sources), and funding and brand origin facts are unverified or null.
